item.title: Council set to rule on Palo Alto Commons expansion as neighbors protest
item.description: Palo Alto’s most contentious development of the year isn’t a tall condominium tower or a sprawling apartment complex but a proposal by Palo Alto Commons to add 11 rooms to its complex, which provides assisted living to seniors. And it is set to return to the spotlight later this month, when the City Council considers the latest itiration of the project.
